text: [57] sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā .pe. sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya . katamehi sattahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti paṭisallīno hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti satimā hoti paññavā hoti imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā .pe. sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti .
